$comment: Ceilings for every shipped wasm artifact, read by `cargo xtask size` against the cargo artifact `cargo xtask dist wasm` ships (the release build with remapped paths, before wasm-bindgen and wasm-opt). Shrink-only: a ceiling more than the headroom above its artifact fails until lowered with `cargo xtask size --update`; raising one is a hand edit, and its reason says why the growth is worth it.

whiteboard-wasm.reason: Production exports only, measured at the cargo artifact: 2368371 bytes, the shipped (wasm-bindgen stripped) module 1497813. Raised by hand for layout_spatial_canvas (ADR-0054 step 7, S14b), the whole layout in one call, as owner decision q70 anticipated: from 1270280 (shipped 787954) the cargo artifact grew 1098091 bytes and the shipped module 709859. Of that, the markdown parser and the mdast conversion (whiteboard-markdown behind whiteboard-codec::parse_markdown_body, linked for the first time) are 329809 of the cargo artifact and 252655 of the shipped module, measured by building with the body parse stubbed out; the rest, 768282 and 457204, is whiteboard-canvas-render entering the artifact for the first time: the composer, the typesetter, line breaking with its generated table, the BudouX model, the theme layer, the font-table measurer and its sfnt reader, the scene writer and the reference host. What else the artifact carries is unchanged: abi_version, edge_route_layout over the router, anchor pass, repair, crossing sweep and side-choice search, the OKF codec behind okf_parse and okf_serialize, the JSON Canvas codec behind json_canvas_parse and json_canvas_serialize, and facet_bucket_check. The per-module layer-2 test exports (the det_* batches, edge_route_on_grid, and each edge module's edge_* export) stay behind the `oracle-surface` cargo feature. Every released build ships this artifact (the npm tarball, the Docker image and the web site); the whole layout's switch defaults to `ts`, so only `differential` and `rust` call it.
